answer: Operator liability escrow binds each new agent identity to a named operator, so a sable account cannot hide behind fresh wallets. If shared-control evidence flags a sybil cluster, the rule suspends that operator across the horizon and forfeits the whole escrow, not just the wallet. Each identity costs the attacker a fixed $50 deposit plus operator-wide lockout, and a wander to a new operator must repay it and pass the same check.
